title: Minecraft Pig
blurb: A short, slightly deflated grunt that millions of players associate with either farming or immediate betrayal, depending on whether they happened to have a saddle. Mojang's animal sounds are deliberately low-fidelity, matching the blocky visuals rather than reaching for realism, and that restraint is the reason one syllable is enough to identify them. Play it for barnyard edits, for unexpected companions, and for any moment involving a creature that trusted you shortly before it shouldn't have. Instantly recognisable to anyone who has ever built a fence.
origin: The pig mob sound from Minecraft (Mojang).
